name_note: Most genomes GTDB places in Pauljensenia are deposited under the earlier names Actinomyces or Schaalia.

sentences.text: Pauljensenia is one of several genera created when a group of species was transferred out of the genus Actinomyces.
Actinomyces organisms, the group from which Pauljensenia was separated, live on mucosal surfaces of the oropharynx and the genitourinary tract.
Shotgun metagenomic sequencing of tongue-coating samples from 92 systemically healthy adults found Pauljensenia among the dominant genera.
A study comparing saliva from 28 patients with cleft lip and palate and 30 healthy controls reported significantly reduced Pauljensenia in the patients.
